notes: 74HC165, NOT LVC. ADR 0001 said so in passing and then chose otherwise: LVC's 'better drive over a 14in chain' is backwards, because over an unterminated line faster edges are what cause reflections. HC's slow edges keep each hop - a ribbon and part of the main board - an ordinary LUMPED LOAD rather than a transmission line. Same SOIC-16; LVC with proper source termination is the way back if E4 disagrees. ONE PER CLUSTER: right_thumb and left_thumb on the main board, right_hand and left_hand on the key boards (ADR 0017). Tie CLK INH low at all four
